query:
UPDATE senate_races SET
  candidate1_bio = 'Julia Letlow is a Republican congresswoman representing Louisiana''s 5th congressional district since 2021. She holds a Ph.D. in Communication from the University of Louisiana at Lafayette and was elected to fill the seat of her late husband Luke Letlow. She serves on the House Appropriations Committee and is a strong advocate for rural healthcare and agriculture.',
  candidate2_bio = 'John Fleming is a Republican politician and former congressman who represented Louisiana''s 4th district from 2009 to 2017. A physician and businessman, he later served as Assistant Secretary of the Army for Acquisition, Logistics and Technology under President Trump. He is a staunch conservative and Trump ally who has focused his Senate campaign on opposing carbon storage projects and cutting federal spending.',
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE state_code = 'LA';
